decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing sits at the edge of the firm's network and infrastructure knowledge, and it faces strong competition from cloud collaboration players, but it can still be bundled with the firm's voice services for now.

The metro data centre connection network builds directly on the firm's owned fibre and carrier-neutral data centres, and early adoption in Hong Kong's financial hub gives clear evidence it can interpret and learn from.
Optical spectrum connectivity is a core capability of its fibre network engineering, has its own dedicated page, and matches the move toward high-bandwidth infrastructure.
The voice number ordering portal applies the firm's software platform and regulatory know-how to its established voice business and supports real-time provisioning.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony offering in a declining market, but it relies on existing voice and regulatory competence and costs little to keep for now.
Direct voice network connection builds on the firm's owned voice network and serves enterprise and service-provider customers it already knows well.
